programme: EBF1 sits at the top of the canonical B-lymphocyte lineage-commitment cascade (its targets PAX5, CD19, CD79A, VPREB1, IGLL1, BCR, PRDM1, GFI1B, FOXO1 are the textbook pre-BCR/B-cell specification set). AKNA co-regulates CD40 and CD40L, the receptor-ligand pair that drives T-cell help to B cells and germinal-centre/immune-synapse formation. ZFPM1 (FOG1), a GATA-cofactor, extends the same differentiation logic across hematopoietic lineages and reaches FOXN1 among its targets — the master regulator of the thymic epithelial cells that normally nurse T-cell development — alongside the Th-associated cytokines IFNG and IL5. Together these three read as one axis: ectopic or dysregulated lymphocyte differentiation and T-B costimulation occurring inside a non-lymphoid parenchyma.
role_in_a: In COPD, small airways develop bronchus-associated lymphoid tissue with organised B-cell follicles and germinal centres that scale with disease severity — a well-established pathological feature of the disease requiring local B-lineage commitment (EBF1-type programme) and T-B costimulatory signalling (CD40-CD40L, AKNA's targets) within lung tissue that does not normally carry this architecture.
role_in_b: Thymoma arises from thymic epithelial cells inside the organ dedicated to lymphocyte education, and it is classically complicated by disorders of that same lymphopoiesis: Good syndrome (thymoma with B-cell aplasia/hypogammaglobulinemia) and thymoma-associated myasthenia gravis both reflect a tumour that has corrupted the normal T- and B-lineage differentiation support the thymus provides — the process ZFPM1's target FOXN1 and AKNA's CD40-CD40L axis sit inside.
shared_axis: Both diseases place the same B-lineage-commitment/T-B-costimulation module inside an organ that is not supposed to be running it in that form — lymphoid neogenesis in COPD airways, and disrupted thymic-stromal lymphopoiesis in thymoma — so recurrence of EBF1, AKNA and ZFPM1 across many patient subgroups in both diseases is consistent with a shared 'lymphoid differentiation gone ectopic/disordered' axis rather than either disease's canonical tissue biology.
reasoning: Tertiary lymphoid structures in COPD airways and thymoma's well-known paraneoplastic lymphopoiesis disorders (Good syndrome, myasthenia gravis) are each independently established features of the two diseases, so a shared lymphocyte-differentiation axis is a reasonable inference. But nothing in the retrieved record actually places EBF1, AKNA or ZFPM1 in either disease (reader's notes report no relevant papers for any of the three), and their Open Targets percentiles are unremarkable (EBF1 ~0.53/0.53) or absent (AKNA, ZFPM1 not scored), so the account rests on general immunology knowledge of the pathway rather than on anything retrieved for this pair.
how_to_falsify: In single-cell/spatial profiling of COPD airway lymphoid follicles, test whether germinal-centre B cells show EBF1/PAX5/CD79A-dependent commitment and whether CD40-CD40L blockade (AKNA's axis) prevents follicle formation in a cigarette-smoke lymphoid-neogenesis model; in parallel, knock down ZFPM1 in thymoma epithelial lines/organoids and ask whether FOXN1-dependent thymic-stromal support and T/B-lymphocyte output are affected. If follicle formation and thymic lymphopoiesis proceed independently of these factors, the shared-axis account is wrong.
caveats: The 130 patient-group comparisons are drawn from only 2 independent cohort pairs, so replication across 'groups' does not mean replication across independent studies. Lung and thymus are functionally unrelated organs (airway epithelium/inflammation vs. a dedicated T-cell-educating stroma), so any shared programme here is necessarily an ectopic or corrupted process in at least one tissue, not a shared normal function. None of the three carrying factors have strong Open Targets association with either disease in this record. The single-view exclusions (OTP, HOXD10, IRX2, BPTF, TBX21, MXD4) matter here specifically because TBX21 (T-bet, a canonical Th1/lymphocyte factor) failed to recur — the account should not be stretched into a broader Th1-polarisation story beyond the B-lineage/CD40 module actually supported by EBF1, AKNA and ZFPM1.
